<!--
  Editable "Highlights" section for the release notes.

  This file is embedded into the "## Highlights" section of every release body
  generated by
  .github/scripts/generate-release-notes.sh.

  How to use it:
    * Edit it in a commit before dispatching a release, OR
    * pass the `changes` input when running the "Build ..." workflow - that
      input wins whenever it is non-empty.

  Keep it short and user-facing: a handful of bullets describing what actually
  changed. Per-patch explanations are generated automatically in the
  "Patches applied" section, and the commit log is generated in "Changelog", so
  do not repeat them here - link to them instead.

  Suggested shape:

  #### New in this build
  - Short, user-visible change one.
  - Short, user-visible change two.

  #### Fixes
  - Bug title: what was broken and how it behaves now.

  #### Notes
  - Anything that needs a workaround (see "Usage and debug options" below).

  HTML comments like this one are not rendered on GitHub, so they are safe to
  leave in place.
-->
